engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

The Warrior remains three distinct stages: Base Warrior at levels 1-2, Arch Juggernaut at levels 3-9, then one Hero path at levels 10-20: Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn. Mutation trees and serums supplement those stages rather than replacing them or functioning as parallel classes.

MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

ACTIVE MUTATIONS. Before Juggernaut Mutation Efficiency, only one equipped mutation can be active at a time. Mutation Efficiency raises the ordinary simultaneous-active limit to two. Transcendent, Apex Form and other explicit features can temporarily exceed that limit. Activating a mutation beyond the current limit ends one active mutation of your choice unless an explicit exception permits otherwise.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

SERUM INJECTION. Unless another feature says otherwise, injecting a prepared serum is a Bonus Action, consumes one prepared dose, activates one equipped mutation for 3 rounds and applies that dose's serum-profile benefits and side effect for the same 3 rounds. Reinjecting the same active mutation refreshes its duration rather than stacking it. Serum-profile numeric bonuses from two doses of the same profile never stack.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

BRUTALITY PROGRESS. Begin each real encounter with Brutality Progress 0 and BT 0. Add actual damage you personally deal to meaningful hostile creatures to Brutality Progress, but a single damage event contributes no more than one-quarter of your maximum HP. Crossing cumulative thresholds equal to 25%, 50% and 75% of your maximum HP grants 1 BT each, subject to the BT cap. Crossing 100% triggers Transcendent as described below but does not create a fourth stored BT unless Stack Overflow or another feature raises the cap.

TAKING DAMAGE AND BT. Once per round when one source deals you actual damage after mitigation equal to or greater than PB + M, gain 1 BT. This direct gain does not increase Brutality Progress. Normal threshold and damage-taken generation together can grant at most 2 BT per round. Explicit card gains such as Overpressure Response or Backlash Engine ignore that generation ceiling but never exceed the current BT cap.

BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

BRUTALITY STATES. At BT 1 you are Awakened; at BT 2 Primed; at BT 3 Unleashed. At Warrior12+, reaching BT4 or crossing100% Brutality Progress may trigger the same once-per-encounter Transcendent pulse, even if your stored cap remains3; it is never an indefinitely active state. State benefits are defined as operational extraCards and vanish immediately if spending BT drops you below their thresholds.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Warrior-caused effect that fully denies its normal turn, such as Stunned, Paralyzed or an equivalent full-turn denial, from your Warrior features per encounter. After the first succeeds, later Warrior effects from you that would fully deny that creature's turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot generate another Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Free attacks granted by Warrior features are explicitly bounded and never recursively grant additional free attacks.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

IMMUNITY AND RESISTANCE. Warrior resistance does not stack with resistance to the same damage type; apply one resistance. Immunity supersedes resistance but multiple immunities provide no additional benefit. If a feature grants several immunities temporarily, each is still only one immunity to that specific type or condition.

MUTATION TIERS. Basic mutations require Warrior 1. Advanced mutations require Warrior 6. Apex mutations require Warrior 15. You may equip only mutations whose actual Warrior class-level gate and other prerequisites you meet. NEW explicit scope reconciliation (FEAT327-ACQ-02): across your single set of unlocked mutation slots, you may equip at most two Advanced mutations from each actual mutation tree and at most one Apex mutation in total across all trees. Basic mutations have no additional tier-count ceiling beyond the remaining unlocked slots. Count every equipped mutation, including a dormant one, toward its relevant equipment ceilings; use its actual source-defined tree and tier. These are equipped-loadout ceilings, not per-tree slot grants, limits on the number of feat identities acquired, or separate active-only tier ceilings. The completed-rest equipping procedure and prohibition on duplicate named mutations remain unchanged. Mutation Efficiency changes only the ordinary global simultaneous-active limit. Transcendent and Apex Form activate only the existing legally equipped loadout and do not waive equipment ceilings, level/prerequisite gates or duplicate restrictions. Apex Form's permanent slot IV is the single Warrior-20 slot unlock, not an additional slot each time the form activates. After a temporary activation exception ends, apply its exact ending procedure and the then-applicable active-mutation limit without refreshing durations or granting an unequipped mutation.

MUTATION FEATS. Mutation feats are not free mutation selections. They become eligible choices at an ASI/feat opportunity or other campaign feat grant once their listed level and mutation prerequisite are met. They do not consume mutation slots unless their own text says otherwise.

HERO MUTATION TREES. Bulwark Mutation Tree, Gore Mutation Tree and Aberrant Mutation Tree are Hero cards that unlock their associated Hero-specific mutation extraCards. Those mutations still occupy normal mutation slots and obey active-mutation, serum and Strain rules.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION. Warrior 1 automatically gains Mutation Slot I and the BT tracker, then chooses 4 Base cards with at least 2 Active. Warrior 2 automatically gains Mutagen Injection, then chooses 2 additional Base cards. Warrior 3 enters Juggernaut and chooses 2 Arch cards with at least 1 Active. Warrior levels 4-9 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Source progression automatic features remain separate and never consume these choices.

At Warrior 10 choose Wardborn, Ironskin or Dreadspawn and choose 2 Hero cards from that path. Levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 each grant one eligible unselected Base or Arch choice. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one Hero-path choice. The chosen Hero Final Form is automatic at Warrior 20 and cannot be selected early. ASI/feat grants remain separate.

SOURCE PROGRESSION RECONCILIATION. Book progression grants Mutation Slot II at 5, Bone Hardened at 6, Serum Overclock at 9, Mutation Slot III at 13, Brutal Adaptation at 15, Reflexive Mutation at 17 and Apex Form at 20 automatically. Registry-only Fighting Style, Second Wind, Action Surge, Extra Attack and draft level features are preserved in excludedRegistryAlternatives and original source evidence. They are not acquired or stacked onto this playtest schedule.

All class gates use Warrior class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. No other class level unlocks Warrior mutation tiers, serum capacity, Juggernaut, Hero paths, Apex mutations or Final Forms.

Finite recovery completion: Mutation Recovery Reserve=3L+M HP after a long rest. Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation, Hemophage Core and their healing enhancements draw from this shared reserve,1point per actual HP healed. No short-rest refill; no gauge, critical hit, free activation or form change replenishes it. Other explicitly limited-use/dose healing retains its own printed limit. This new test reserve prevents indefinite regenerative healing from free mutation activations.
workedExample: Warrior 6 example: chosen ability Strength 18 gives M=4; assume PB=3, S=2, maximum HP 60, two mutation slots and Mutation Efficiency. The Warrior equips Ironhide Graft and Shock Muscle Weave, prepares Overdrive and Stonecore, begins a real encounter at BT0, Brutality Progress0 and Strain0.

Turn 1: Bonus Action Serum Injection consumes the Overdrive dose, activates Ironhide Graft for 3 rounds and adds Strain 0→1. Overdrive grants +2 Strength and +10 feet Speed; its side effect gives -1 AC. Ironhide grants its own active mutation defenses. The Warrior then deals 18 actual damage; Brutality Progress becomes18, crossing the 15-point 25% threshold and granting BT0→1.

Enemy round: one attack deals 11 actual damage after mitigation. PB+M is7, so the damage-taken rule grants BT1→2, subject to the round generation cap. At BT2 the Warrior is Primed. The damage itself does not add to Brutality Progress.

Turn 2: Serum Injection consumes Stonecore, activates Shock Muscle Weave alongside Ironhide because Mutation Efficiency permits two active mutations, and adds Strain1→2. Stonecore grants +2 AC and knockback immunity but -10 feet Speed. Strain2 separately applies -5 feet Speed. The Warrior deals 20 damage, Brutality Progress18→38, crossing the 30-point 50% threshold; BT is already2 so it becomes3.

Turn 3: with BT3 the Warrior is Unleashed and uses Brutality Unleashed, spending all3 BT. BT3→0. Enemies in the burst make the printed Strength save and take the area damage. Spending BT immediately ends Awakened, Primed and Unleashed state benefits, but active mutations and serum durations continue independently.

Turn 4: the Warrior uses Mutation Surge on Ironhide, adding 1 Strain. Strain2→3, so the Strain3 AC/save penalty applies after the activation. Until Strain falls below3, another voluntary Serum Injection, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge is illegal. A later completed short rest reduces Strain3→2 but does not refill either consumed serum dose.
balanceQuestions: Do BT accumulation, the three stored states and the 100%-progress Transcendent pulse create a meaningful escalating fight rhythm without making high-damage builds enter Unleashed or Transcendent too early?
Are mutation slots, active-mutation concurrency, serum dose scarcity and Strain restrictive enough to make preparation meaningful without leaving Warrior powerless after only one or two encounters?

Do Wardborn mitigation, Ironskin regeneration/adaptation and Dreadspawn control/damage remain comparable after all mutation-tree, Apex and serum interactions are active, especially around Extra Attack and free-attack sources?
cards: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

Combat Instinct. Gain +1 on initiative rolls. You cannot be Surprised while conscious unless the opposing creature's Stealth check exceeds your passive Perception by 5 or more. This does not grant extra Actions or movement before combat.

Physical Conditioning. Increase carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting capacity by 25%. You have advantage on Constitution checks and saving throws made specifically against forced marching, sustained physical exertion, suffocation from exertion or environmental fatigue.
Hostile creatures you can perceive within 60 feet

Brutality Sense. You know when a visible hostile creature is at or below one-quarter of its maximum HP; it is Vulnerable for your Warrior features that specifically reference a marked vulnerable target. This does not reveal its exact HP or hidden resistances.
At will while legal doses remain

Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.
One creature within your weapon reach
Instantaneous; Stagger until end of target's next turn

Brutal Strike. Make one melee weapon attack using its normal ability. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon's type. The target makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Staggered, taking -1 on attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. This is not a full-turn denial.
Until start of your next regular turn

Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.
Up to3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you

Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.
Until start of your next regular turn

Survival Instinct. Gain +2 on Perception checks, +2 on Dexterity saving throws and one additional Reaction usable only for Dodge-like defensive reactions, opportunity-free movement granted by a feature, or Deflect-style mitigation. It cannot make an attack or trigger another additional Reaction.

Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

Brutal Fortitude. Reduce damage you take by 1 for each current BT, to a maximum DR 3 from this feature. Stack Overflow can raise your BT cap to 4 but does not raise Brutal Fortitude above DR 3. Losing or spending BT immediately lowers this DR.
3 rounds or its shorter printed duration

Overpressure Response. When you take a critical hit, choose one equipped dormant non-Apex mutation and activate it without consuming a serum dose or gaining Strain. This activation must respect your normal simultaneous-active-mutation limit; if necessary, make another active mutation dormant. It grants no serum-profile benefit and cannot activate a mutation whose prerequisite you do not meet.
Self; 20-foot straight movement path and creatures crossed or approached within 5 feet

Crushing Advance. Move up to 20 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy no more than one size larger whose space or reach-line you pass through or adjacent to makes a Strength save. On failure it takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage, is pushed to the nearest legal space outside your path and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is neither pushed nor Prone. A creature is affected once per use.
Until end of your next regular turn

Pain Conversion. After one damage event deals actual damage to you, gain a temporary Power bonus equal to floor(actual damage/10), minimum 1 and maximum 3. Until the end of your next regular turn, add that bonus to one Strength-based weapon damage roll or Strength check. A later trigger refreshes the duration and replaces the previous bonus rather than stacking.
Until completion of a short or long rest
One remembered damage type at a time

Adaptive Tissue. When a critical hit deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage to you, gain resistance to one such damage type dealt by that hit until you complete a short or long rest. Gaining a new Adaptive Tissue resistance replaces the previous one. Immunity and duplicate resistance do not stack.

Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.
2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn

Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.
Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain

Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
Spend all 3 BT; requires Unleashed state
Enemies of your choice within 15 feet
At will when requirement is met

Brutality Unleashed. Spend all 3 BT. Each chosen enemy within 15 feet makes a Strength save, taking (S+1)d8 + M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Spending the BT immediately ends Awakened, Primed and Unleashed state benefits. This is one area attack and cannot generate BT or Brutality Progress from its own damage.

Survival Adaptation. Choose one hazard when activated: extreme heat, extreme cold, poisonous atmosphere, high altitude/low oxygen, corrosive environment or difficult natural terrain. For 3 rounds you ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard; if it deals acid, cold, fire or poison damage, you instead gain resistance to that one damage type. This grants no immunity and does not protect allies.
Up to3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see you

Intimidating Transformation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would instead be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A target succeeding on the initial save is immune to this use. The transformation does not force surrender or belief changes.

Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.
Allies within 5 feet while you have at least one active mutation

Protective Mutations. While at least one mutation is active, each ally other than you within 5 feet reduces the first damage it takes each round by S, minimum 0. Multiple Protective Mutations do not stack. The protection ends immediately when the ally leaves the aura or you have no active mutation.
One willing living ally you touch
At most once per ally per short rest

Serum Sharing. Inject one willing ally with a diluted prepared serum. The ally receives half of each positive numeric benefit of that serum profile, rounded down with minimum 1, for 3 rounds; nonnumeric immunities become advantage on the relevant save instead. The serum activates no mutation in the ally. The ally gains 1 Strain for this pilot and suffers the profile's printed side effect. Your Serum Tolerance does not protect the ally.

Controlled Transformation. You can suppress obvious cosmetic signs of dormant mutations and reduce visible manifestations of active mutations enough to pass as merely scarred or unusually built while fully clothed. You gain advantage on checks to conceal your Warrior mutations from casual visual inspection. This never suppresses mechanical mutation effects, defeats magical detection or conceals transformations whose cards explicitly make you Large, monstrous or otherwise impossible to hide.

Final Form – Aegis Incarnate. For 3 rounds you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone. Whenever an ally within 15 feet takes damage, automatically redirect half that damage rounded down to yourself after the ally's resistance but before its temporary HP; the ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its type, cannot be reduced again or generate BT, and cannot be redirected again. If taking the redirected damage would kill you outright, the redirection still occurs. This grants no extra Reaction requirement and does not stack with Guardian Tissue on the same damage event.

Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.
One ally within 10 feet when your turn ends
Until start of your next regular turn

Mutated Guard. If you end your turn within 10 feet of at least one ally, choose one such ally. Until the start of your next regular turn it gains +1 on saving throws and reduces the first damage it takes by 1. This benefit does not stack with another Mutated Guard.
One adjacent ally and triggering attacker

Guardian Pulse. Trigger when an adjacent ally is targeted by an attack. You become the target instead; resolve the original attack roll against your AC and defenses. After that attack fully resolves, if the attacker is within your melee reach, make one melee weapon attack against it. This counterattack is a free attack, cannot grant another free attack or Action, and occurs whether the redirected attack hit or missed.
Self; protects one ally within 10 feet at a time

Warding Mutation. Grow temporary protective plates for 3 rounds. At the start of each of your turns choose one ally within 10 feet. Until the start of your next turn, the first time that ally takes damage reduce it by S+M, minimum 0. The prevented damage is simply negated rather than transferred. This is a temporary transformation, not an equipped mutation, and cannot stack with itself.
At most once per target per long rest

Stabilizing Injection. The target regains 2d8 + M HP and may end one of Poisoned, Frightened or Staggered. If Diseased, it may immediately repeat one saving throw the disease normally permits. This removes no Wounds, cannot restore the dead and does not activate a mutation or apply the consumed serum's normal profile.
Until 10 minutes after leaving the environment

Environmental Adaptation. After 1 uninterrupted minute exposed to extreme heat, extreme cold, high altitude/low oxygen, poisonous atmosphere or another Director-defined natural environmental hazard, adapt to it. Ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that hazard and gain advantage on saves against it. Adapting to a new environment replaces the previous adaptation. This does not grant damage immunity.
Spend healing amount from Mutation Recovery Reserve
While at least one mutation is active in a real encounter
Once at the start of each regular turn

Regenerative Mutation. At the start of your regular turn during a real encounter, if at least one mutation is active and you are below maximum HP, regain S+M HP. This regeneration functions only during a real encounter, cannot restore the dead or remove Wounds, and cannot be increased by remaining in initiative without meaningful opposition. Each HP actually restored spends1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal only up to remaining reserve.
One serum dose you are consuming

Serum Recycling. Whenever you would consume a prepared serum dose, roll a d20. On 17-20, the dose is not consumed after its effects resolve. Strain and all other costs still apply. A preserved dose remains in its original prepared profile and cannot increase your serum reserve above its normal capacity.
Until completion of a short or long rest
Tracks one damage type at a time

Damage Memory. When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder damage, begin or continue remembering that type. The first subsequent damage event of the same type is reduced by 1, the next by 2 and later events by 3, maximum DR 3. Taking a different listed type replaces the remembered type and resets the progression. Resistance applies separately and never upgrades this feature to immunity.

Final Form – Adaptive Perfection. Choose up to three damage types from acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder that have actually damaged you since your last long rest, plus one environmental hazard you personally experienced during that period. For 3 rounds you are immune to the chosen damage types and ignore ordinary penalties from the chosen hazard. You cannot choose a type or hazard you did not actually encounter, and multiple immunity sources do not stack.

Gore Mutation Tree. Unlock the Ironskin-specific mutations Gore Maw, Reinforced Joints and Shard Skin as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card equips or activates none of them automatically.

Stack Overflow. Increase your stored BT cap from 3 to 4. Brutal Fortitude remains capped at DR 3. At BT 4 you count as Transcendent for features that explicitly reference stored BT 4, but reaching BT 4 does not itself activate every mutation unless the common Transcendent state says so.

Auto-Rupture. When your stored BT first reaches its current maximum during a round, each enemy within 5 feet makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone. The shockwave deals no damage, spends no BT and cannot retrigger from remaining at maximum BT; you must fall below the cap and later reach it again.

Adaptive Mutation. Trigger when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or another Director-approved environmental damage type, or when an environmental hazard forces you to make a saving throw. Gain resistance to that damage type or advantage on saves against that specific hazard for 3 rounds. Choose one if both apply. This is a temporary transformation and consumes no mutation slot or serum.
Until start of your next regular turn, then instantaneous recovery

Cellular Reconstruction. Enter stasis until the start of your next regular turn: your Speed becomes 0, you cannot take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions, and attacks against you have advantage. At the start of your next turn regain 3d8 + M HP and end Poisoned plus one mundane or magical disease that does not explicitly require a special cure. This removes no Wounds and cannot function while dead.
Up to3 enemies within 15 feet that can see you
Until end of target's next turn
At most once per target per round

Horrific Appearance. Whenever you activate a mutation, each qualifying enemy within 15 feet makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. A creature already Frightened by this feature is not forced to save again until that instance ends. This never forces surrender or changes beliefs.
One creature hit by your weapon or natural attack
Until end of target's next turn

Infectious Mutation. After you hit a creature, roll a d10. On a 10, painful temporary growths erupt: the target takes S psychic damage and has -1 on its next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn, whichever occurs first. This is not a permanent mutation, disease or body alteration and cannot spread or reproduce.
Self and creatures exposed to your serum or blood

Serum Toxicity. A creature other than you that is directly injected with one of your prepared serum doses takes S d6 poison damage after the injection unless a feature expressly makes that serum safe; this damage does not create BT. Additionally, once per round when a creature within 5 feet deals piercing or slashing melee damage to you, it takes S acid damage from your blood. The retaliation cannot recursively trigger itself.

Pain Empowerment. For every full 10% of your maximum HP currently missing, add +1 damage to one weapon or natural-weapon damage roll on each of your turns, maximum +5. Determine the bonus immediately before the chosen damage roll. Healing can reduce the bonus during the encounter. It does not increase mutation retaliation, ongoing damage or area effects.

Final Form – Abomination Ascendant. For 3 rounds your melee reach increases by 5 feet, your Speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a natural Claw attack dealing 2d8 + M slashing damage. At the start of each enemy's turn within 30 feet that can see you, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of that turn. The hard-control guard still applies to any other denial effect you use. This transformation grants no free attacks or additional Actions.

Aberrant Mutation Tree. Unlock the Dreadspawn-specific mutations Whip-Tendon Limbs, Soul Spike Carapace and Hemophage Core as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not equip or activate any of them.

Terror Radius. For 3 rounds, at the start of each enemy's turn within 15 feet it makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers -1 AC and -1 on morale checks until the start of its next turn. Each turn grants a new save. The effect does not stack with itself and does not reduce saving throws or attack rolls.

Apex Aberration. For 2 rounds increase Strength by 4, maximum 24 from this feature. You are immune to the effects and damage of hostile rank-3-or-lower spells, but not higher-rank spells, non-spell magical abilities or friendly spells you choose to accept. Whenever your weapon or natural attack hits, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the cap.
Up to3 enemies of your choice within 20 feet that can see or hear you

Horrific Mutation. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn and then repeats the save. On a failure by 10 or more, it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Warrior hard-control guard. A successful initial save grants immunity to this use. This transformation does not compel surrender or obedience.
Self; your melee weapon and natural attacks

Toxic Secretion. For 3 rounds, once on each of your turns when a melee weapon or natural attack hits, add S d4 poison damage. The target then makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Repeated applications refresh rather than stack. Poison immunity prevents both the condition and poison damage as normal.

extraCards.name: Brutal Adaptation
extraCards.effect: After each completed short or long rest choose one equipped mutation. Gain one of its passive numeric benefits at half value rounded down, minimum1 where applicable, even while that mutation is dormant. Damage dice, control, immunity, regeneration and trigger effects cannot be selected.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 17, legal serum dose and Strain below3
extraCards.name: Reflexive Mutation
extraCards.effect: When you take damage or fail a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution save, inject one prepared serum and activate one eligible equipped mutation before subsequent effects from the triggering event resolve. It cannot retroactively undo damage or a failed save.

extraCards.name: Apex Form
extraCards.effect: Gain mutation slot IV permanently. When Apex Form activates, all equipped mutations become active for3 rounds without consuming serum doses and ignore the normal active-mutation concurrency limit. Serum-profile effects are not granted. When the form ends, choose active mutations up to your normal limit; all others become dormant.

extraCards.name: Awakened
extraCards.effect: Once per encounter, when a serum activation would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by1, minimum0. This represents reduced activation cost; it cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below1 Strain.

extraCards.name: Primed
extraCards.effect: Enhance one active mutation's numeric benefit for the turn: +1 to one AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage bonus; +5 feet to one movement/reach bonus; or +1 damage/healing to one mutation-generated roll. Primed never increases duration, targets, immunity or resource generation.

extraCards.name: Unleashed
extraCards.effect: You satisfy the Brutality Threshold requirement for Brutality Unleashed and other features explicitly requiring the Unleashed state.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior12;100% Brutality Progress or BT4 with raised cap; new explicit level gate
extraCards.name: Transcendent
extraCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: At Warrior12+, the first time this encounter you cross100% Brutality Progress or reach stored BT4, activate all equipped mutations until start of your next regular turn. No serum profile or immediate healing trigger is granted. This is one total pulse, never a permanent BT4 concurrency increase. At end choose active mutations up to normal limit, with their original remaining durations; others become dormant.

extraCards.name: Overdrive
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 to Strength or Dexterity, chosen on preparation, and +10 feet Speed. Side effect: -1 AC for the duration. Serum Tolerance suppresses the side effect but not Strain.

extraCards.name: Stonecore
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 AC and immunity to forced movement or knockback from creatures no more than one size larger. Side effect: Speed -10 feet. Serum Tolerance suppresses the Speed penalty.

extraCards.name: Sanguine Surge
extraCards.frequency: Per prepared dose; same creature cannot receive its healing more than once per short rest
extraCards.effect: On injection regain 2d6 HP and gain +10 feet Speed for3 rounds. Side effect: when the profile ends gain1 additional Strain, maximum3. Serum Tolerance suppresses that ending side effect. This healing removes no Wounds and cannot operate on a dead creature.

extraCards.name: Mind Shock
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 on saving throws against spells. Once during the duration gain one additional Reaction usable only for movement, defense, Counterspell-like disruption already possessed or another non-attack reaction; it cannot make an attack. Side effect: -1 on Perception checks for the duration. Serum Tolerance suppresses that penalty.

extraCards.name: Chromatic Flux
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth checks when at least lightly obscured and choose extreme heat or extreme cold; you ignore ordinary environmental penalties from that choice during the duration. Side effect: vivid discoloration gives disadvantage on attempts to pass as physically unaltered. Serum Tolerance suppresses that social side effect.

extraCards.name: Berserker Brew
extraCards.effect: You are immune to Frightened and once on each of your turns add 2S damage to one melee weapon or natural-weapon hit. Side effect: -1 AC and you cannot voluntarily take Dodge or Disengage. Serum Tolerance suppresses the side effect but not the once-per-turn damage cap.

extraCards.name: Ironhide Graft
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 AC against melee attack rolls and reduce the first physical weapon damage you take each round by1.

extraCards.name: Bloodthick Node
extraCards.duration: While active during a real encounter
extraCards.frequency: Once at start of each regular turn
extraCards.effect: Regain HP equal to current BT, maximum3 HP per turn or4 with Stack Overflow. No healing occurs outside a real encounter and it removes no Wounds. Each HP actually restored spends1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

extraCards.name: Spinal Buffer
extraCards.effect: Gain +1 on saving throws against being knocked Prone, Stunned or forcibly moved. If an effect uses an ability check rather than a save, add +1 to that check instead.

extraCards.name: Flesh Warden
extraCards.effect: Increase maximum HP by2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

extraCards.name: Plated Shoulder
extraCards.effect: While adjacent to substantial terrain, a wall or a willing ally of your size or larger, you gain half cover against ranged attacks.

extraCards.name: Redundant Organs
extraCards.effect: When damage would reduce you to0 HP without killing you outright, remain at1 HP instead.

extraCards.name: Rapid Coagulation
extraCards.duration: While active during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: If you did not move during your previous turn, regain2 HP at the start of your current turn. This does not function outside a real encounter. Each HP actually restored spends1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

extraCards.name: Ossified Core
extraCards.effect: Critical hits against you do not add extra critical damage dice. Additionally reduce piercing damage you take by2 after resistance.

extraCards.name: Adrenal Floodgate
extraCards.effect: When you first fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, regain2d8 HP and end either Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered on yourself.

extraCards.name: Thickened Bone Weave
extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: When you activate a serum or gain at least1 BT, gain DR2 against physical weapon damage until the end of your next regular turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped
extraCards.name: Mythic Carapace
extraCards.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
extraCards.effect: Gain DR3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than20 actual damage after mitigation, gain1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.

extraCards.name: Brute Knuckles
extraCards.effect: Your unarmed strike damage die becomes1d10. On an unarmed critical hit, the target makes a Strength save; on failure it drops one non-attuned held item of its choice.

extraCards.name: Splinter Bone Fangs
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
extraCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
extraCards.effect: A melee critical applies Bleed. The target takes1d4 physical damage at the start of each of its next2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

extraCards.name: Lashing Ligaments
extraCards.effect: For one melee attack on your turn, increase your reach by5 feet. Using the extended reach does not itself provoke opportunity attacks.

extraCards.name: Jaw Clench Node
extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: After you score a critical hit, gain +1 on attack rolls and +2 on Intimidation checks until the end of your next regular turn.

extraCards.name: Shoulder Spike Cluster
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature grappling you or grappled by you
extraCards.effect: When a grapple is established or maintained against you, or you successfully establish a grapple, the other creature takes1d6 piercing damage.

extraCards.name: Shock Muscle Weave
extraCards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee weapon attack. This additional attack is not a new Action and cannot itself grant another attack. It does not apply to card techniques unless they explicitly use the ordinary Attack action.

extraCards.name: Razorbone Growths
extraCards.effect: Your melee attacks ignore1 point of flat DR. Resistance and immunity are unaffected.

extraCards.name: Echo Knuckles
extraCards.effect: After you hit with a melee attack, make one offhand slam against the same target using your Warrior technique attack. On hit deal1d8+M bludgeoning damage. This is a free attack, cannot trigger Echo Knuckles again and cannot grant another free attack.

extraCards.name: Adrenal Backlash Core
extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: After you take damage, empower your next melee hit before the end of your next regular turn to deal +2d6 damage of the weapon's normal type. A new trigger refreshes but does not stack.

extraCards.name: Warpgrip Talons
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
extraCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
extraCards.effect: A melee critical applies Weakened for2 rounds. While Weakened, the target deals1 less damage with each weapon or natural-weapon hit, minimum0. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped
extraCards.name: Butcherform Chassis
extraCards.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
extraCards.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.

extraCards.name: Ink-Slick Glands
extraCards.effect: Create opaque black mist. Creatures outside the cloud cannot see through it; ranged attacks passing through the cloud have disadvantage. Wind or an equivalent dispersal effect may end it early.

extraCards.name: Pulsing Vein Spiral
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 on Intimidation checks. Enemies within5 feet take -1 on morale checks or the campaign's equivalent morale roll; this does not alter attack rolls or saving throws.

extraCards.name: Tremor Claws
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
extraCards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
extraCards.effect: After a melee critical, the target makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone.

extraCards.name: Rib Lash Tendrils
extraCards.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes1d4 psychic damage. This retaliation cannot trigger itself or other retaliation loops.

extraCards.name: Bone Lure Growth
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it must use up to15 feet of its available movement to move toward you by the safest path. This movement cannot force it into obviously lethal terrain and never consumes its Action.

extraCards.name: Throat Split Maw
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: You gain a bite attack dealing1d8+M piercing damage. When the bite hits a creature capable of casting spells, it makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Silenced until the end of its next turn.

extraCards.name: Viral Core Sacs
extraCards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: When you activate a serum, enemies within10 feet make Constitution saves. On failure they have disadvantage on their next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn.

extraCards.name: Scythebone Spikes
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Your unarmed strike target and one different adjacent creature
extraCards.effect: When an unarmed strike hits, choose one different enemy within5 feet of the original target. If the same attack roll would hit that enemy's AC, it takes damage equal to the unarmed strike's base damage die without modifiers. This cleave is not another attack and triggers no on-hit effects.

extraCards.name: Carrion Signal Gland
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature that hits you in melee
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: The attacker makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Shaken, taking -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

extraCards.name: Wailing Eye Cluster
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies make Wisdom saves. On failure they become Disoriented: at the start of their next turn they cannot take Reactions and their first5 feet of movement must be in a random legal horizontal direction determined by the Director. They otherwise keep their normal Action and movement.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Aberrant; maximum one Apex equipped
extraCards.name: Voidbirth Shell
extraCards.effect: You may move through enemy spaces and nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost but cannot end inside a creature or solid object. Enemies within15 feet take -1 on attack rolls and morale. At the end of each of your turns create one 1-HP clone in an adjacent legal space, maximum2 clones. A clone cannot attack or block movement; when destroyed it explodes, creatures within5 feet make Dexterity saves taking2d6 psychic on failure or half on success. Clones grant no resources, corpses, XP or BT.

extraCards.name: Spinal Plating
extraCards.effect: Reduce damage you take from area effects by2 after resistance.

extraCards.name: Adrenal Overwatch
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within weapon reach that damages an ally within5 feet of you
extraCards.effect: Make one melee weapon attack against the triggering enemy. This free attack cannot grant another free attack or additional Action.

extraCards.name: Living Cover
extraCards.effect: Adjacent allies gain +2 AC against ranged attacks while you are conscious and not Prone. This does not stack with another Living Cover.

extraCards.name: Gore Maw
extraCards.effect: Gain a bite attack dealing1d8+M piercing. On hit once per turn, the target takes1d4 Bleed damage at the start of its next2 turns. Reapplication refreshes.

extraCards.name: Reinforced Joints
extraCards.effect: You are immune to being knocked Prone by creatures no more than one size larger. Effects from larger creatures instead grant advantage on your save against being knocked Prone.

extraCards.name: Shard Skin
extraCards.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes1d4 piercing damage. This retaliation cannot trigger another retaliation.

extraCards.name: Whip-Tendon Limbs
extraCards.effect: Increase melee reach by5 feet. Once per turn after a melee hit against a creature no more than one size larger, it makes a Strength save; on failure pull it up to5 feet toward you.

extraCards.name: Soul Spike Carapace
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies within10 feet after your melee critical
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; fear until end next turn
extraCards.effect: When you score a melee critical, gain1 BT, then enemies of your choice within10 feet make Wisdom saves. Failure Frightens them until the end of their next turn. The BT gain cannot exceed your cap.

extraCards.name: Hemophage Core
extraCards.effect: When you personally reduce a meaningful hostile creature to0 HP with a melee attack, regain2d6 HP. Summoned, trivial, friendly or repeatedly revived creatures cannot trigger this healing. Each HP actually restored spends1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; Bloodthick Node equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Bio-Stabilizer
extraCards.effect: While at least two mutations are active, Bloodthick Node heals1 additional HP on each of its valid encounter-only regeneration pulses.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Ossified Core equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Juggernaut's Core
extraCards.effect: While Ossified Core is active, reduce extra damage explicitly granted by Sneak Attack or equivalent precision-damage features by half, rounded down. Ordinary weapon damage is unaffected.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; three Vital mutations equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Living Fortress
extraCards.frequency: While at least three Vital mutations are active
extraCards.effect: You cannot grant advantage to an enemy solely because it is flanking you. Other sources of advantage still apply.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; any Apex mutation equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Evolution Under Fire
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One Warrior ability with positive recharge
extraCards.effect: When one damage event deals more than15 actual damage to you, reduce one positive Warrior round-recharge counter by1, minimum0, subject to the universal reset/shortening cap.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; two Combat mutations equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Kill-Chain Adaptation
extraCards.duration: Until end of next regular turn
extraCards.effect: After you personally reduce a meaningful hostile creature to0 HP with a melee attack, gain +10 feet Speed and +1 on your next melee attack roll before the end of your next regular turn.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Adrenal Backlash Core equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Backlash Engine
extraCards.effect: While Adrenal Backlash Core is active, the first time each round you take actual damage, gain1 BT, never above the current cap.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Echo Knuckles and Warpgrip Talons equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Eviscerator Protocol
extraCards.frequency: When Echo Knuckles hits, once per round
extraCards.effect: Choose Bleed or Weakened. Bleed deals1d4 damage at the start of the target's next2 turns. Weakened causes -1 damage on weapon and natural-weapon hits for2 rounds. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; Butcherform Chassis equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Hypermutation Spike
extraCards.effect: When Butcherform Chassis activates, extend its maximum duration from3 rounds to5. During that activation you are immune to Stunned and your Speed cannot be reduced below half its normal value.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 4; any Aberrant mutation equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Distorted Dominance
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creature failing a save against your Aberrant mutation
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: When a creature fails a save against your Aberrant mutation, it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. This provisional normalization replaces the source's undefined loss of an action and does not fully deny the target's turn.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Carrion Signal Gland equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Terror Engine
extraCards.effect: While at least two hostile creatures within30 feet are currently Shaken, Frightened or Disoriented by your Warrior features, reduce the first damage you take each round by2.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 16; any Apex mutation equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Born to Horrify
extraCards.frequency: Once per regular turn while an Apex mutation is active
extraCards.effect: When you fail a saving throw while an Apex mutation is active, reroll it and use the new result. This can occur at most once on each of your regular turns, not once per enemy turn.

extraCards.prerequisite: Warrior 8; Wailing Eye Cluster or Viral Core Sacs equipped; eligible feat grant
extraCards.name: Synaptic Rot
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within15 feet failing a Wisdom or Intelligence save against your Warrior feature
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: When the target fails the qualifying save, it is Silenced until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent non-spell abilities.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.prerequisite: Warrior 1; registry-derived, not present in the quoted book progression
excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Fighting Style
excludedRegistryAlternatives.frequency: Automatic only if this registry feature is retained for the playtest
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Choose one existing approved martial Fighting Style for which you qualify. This card preserves the runtime registry entry and does not invent a new style list.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Second Wind
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Regain 1d10 + Warrior level HP. This cannot exceed maximum HP, revive you from death or remove Wounds.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Action Surge
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Gain one additional full Action this turn, subject to the universal one-additional-full-Action-per-creature-per-round cap. This Action cannot generate another additional Action.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Extra Attack
excludedRegistryAlternatives.frequency: Whenever you take the ordinary Attack action
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make two weapon attacks instead of one. Free attacks and card techniques do not automatically inherit this extra attack unless explicitly written.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Expanded Serum Rack
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Prepared serum reserve increases from2 to3 doses. Serum Sharing no longer adds an extra Strain to you merely because the injected target is an ally; the ally's own strain still applies.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Transcendent Brutality Window
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: When Brutality Progress first reaches100% of your maximum HP during an encounter, you may enter Transcendent for3 rounds instead of the normal one-round pulse. All equipped mutations count as active during this window but serum-profile effects are not granted.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Ability Score Improvement — Warrior 14
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Choose the campaign's normal ASI option or one eligible feat. Mutation feats are legal choices if their prerequisites are met.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Serum Toxicity Resistance
excludedRegistryAlternatives.frequency: Always; ignore strain once per encounter
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: An ally injected through Serum Sharing gains half the normal Strain from that injection, rounded up. Once per encounter when you share a serum with an ally within10 feet, that ally may instead gain0 Strain from that activation.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Mutation Slot IV Preview
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Temporarily equip and activate one eligible fourth mutation for3 rounds without replacing a prepared mutation. The preview ignores BT gating but not mutation level or Hero-tree prerequisites. When it ends gain1 Strain; if already at3, take S d6 unavoidable damage instead.

excludedRegistryAlternatives.name: Ability Score Improvement — Warrior 19
excludedRegistryAlternatives.effect: Choose the campaign's normal ASI option or one eligible feat. Mutation feats are legal choices if their prerequisites are met.
